narrative.overview: The app is the shop's own front at Khedi Market, Kohima: hand-painted enamel colour on boards, condensed sign lettering, and a shelf of products that is always the clearest thing on screen. Premium comes from motion and type, not ornament: the OPEN/CLOSED board swings and flips, offer boards are a deck you flick away, the order-placed sign drops in on its strings; everything else is quick, quiet feedback.
keyCharacteristics: Solid enamel colour fields, no gradients, glows or glass.
Condensed sign caps for headings, prices, tags and buttons; a sturdy grotesque for reading.
Flat boards separated by tone steps; shadows only on things that float.
One action colour (chrome yellow); green for selection and shell; red for offers and alerts.
Motion explains state and stays under 300ms for routine UI; physical swings and drops are the only long moves.

rules.name: The One Paint For Action Rule
rules.body: Chrome yellow is the only colour that asks for a tap. Green selects, red warns; neither is ever a primary call to action.

rules.name: The Fixed Red Board Rule
rules.body: A board painted red (offers, ticker) uses #cf1f2b in light and dark; theme-adaptive red is for text and small tags only.

rules.name: The Painted Detail Rule
rules.body: Big lettering on a painted board carries the signwriter's flat shade, and those boards carry a painted keyline 6px inside the edge. Nowhere else.

rules.name: The Sign Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase lives only in the display face. Body-face text is always sentence case; no tiny tracked labels.

rules.name: The Flat Board Rule
rules.body: A board at rest has no border and no shadow. If it needs separation, step its tone.

dos: Do paint shell surfaces solid signboard green (#0a4d3b) and keep product boards white on limewash (#eef2ee).
Do use chrome yellow (#f5b800) for every primary action and nothing decorative.
Do set headings, prices and action labels in Big Shoulders Display caps; roll changing numbers with NumberFlow.
Do use ease-out cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) for UI, the drawer curve cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1) for sheets, and springs (bounce 0.15-0.3) for physical objects.
Do keep content visible by default; scroll reveals only hide items once the watcher script is running, and reduced motion removes travel.
donts: Don't use gradients, glows, aurora or beam backgrounds, or blurred glass panels (the owner chose skills-first over Aceternity's look).
Don't put borders or shadows on boards at rest.
Don't use red for anything but offers, closed status and errors.
Don't set body text in uppercase or add small tracked labels above headings.
Don't animate keyboard actions or routine state changes longer than 300ms.
